title: Author an affix process
description: Stages a new affix entry whose ordered input pattern matches phonemes, a natural class or the remaining stem, and whose output copies named parts, inserts phonemes, inserts a segment of a natural class, or copies a part with the features of a feature class laid over it: an infix, a partial or full reduplication, or a substitution that deletes matched input by omitting it from the output (Cebuano paN- before p/b gives m). It refuses an output that copies nothing or drops the remaining stem. Dry Run and Trial before a person Applies the Proposal.
